item.tib: gtor dbang shog gcig sku gsum chu rgyun
item.coloph: 'di nyid shin tu zab pa las ldan gyi slob ma la zur du ston cig kun la bstan na dbyings nas bka' chad 'byung bas/ gcig brgyud (rgyud) bka' rgya gdab/ bdag 'dra dran pa nam mkha' yis/ yang zab gter dbang shog gcig bstan/ gcig rdzogs 'di 'dra gzhan na med/ bI ro mkhas pa khyod la gtad/ las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog rgya rgya rgya gter rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gab rgya dpal srid pa'i rgyal mo'i (mos) gnyer dang bya ra mdzod cig
